results.title: Breakfasts from 12 countries that look nothing alike
results.description: Climate, culture, agriculture and centuries of tradition have shaped breakfast tables in fascinating ways, proving that there is no universal definition of a “proper” morning meal. Here’s a look at 12 breakfasts that couldn’t be more different from one another.

results.title: “How dumb you have to be”: WNBA gets heavily trolled after futile attempt to delete Angel Reese and Paige Bueckers’ betting video from their official page
results.description: The WNBA's official social media team posted, then quickly deleted, a video showing Angel Reese and Paige Bueckers agreeing to a $400 wager on their teams' matchup, an act that appears to violate Section 5(c) of the league's Collective Bargaining Agreement. The deletion drew immediate ridicule online rather than quieting the story. Hours later, Reese and Bueckers clashed on the court during Dallas's 38-32 halftime lead over Atlanta.
